verses.1: A song for Jehovah, a new song. It was created by His mercy; His right hand and His holy one have made it possible.
verses.2: The LORD revealed His salvation to the eyes of the nations, thereby showing His righteousness.
verses.3: They remembered His kindness and mercy toward the house of Israel. All the people of the earth saw the salvation that our God brought.
verses.4: All the nations praised the LORD; they sang and rejoiced.
verses.5: Sing to Jehovah with instruments and songs.
verses.6: In the courts and with loud voices, they praised before the king, Jehovah.
verses.7: The sea will rage, and the Mediterranean will be filled with waves. And those who live there will be destroyed.
verses.8: The rivers wash away the stones together; they nourish us along the mountains.
verses.9: Before the LORD, for He will come to judge the earth. He will judge Tiberias with righteousness, and nations with fairness.
